description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different categories, comparing the proportions of various groups. The chart is divided into seven slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding proportions are: Math (29.3%, red), Coding (24.3%, blue), Information Seeking (22.2%, light green), Reasoning (10.4%, orange), Others (combined) (9.3%, dark green), Planning (2.3%, purple), and Creative Writing (2.2%, pink). The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to their respective categories, and the percentage values are labeled directly on the chart. The slices are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with the largest slice, Math, positioned at the top left and the smallest slices, Planning and Creative Writing, positioned near the top right.
